description:
# 1.0.0

Initial ReVanced Patches Legacy release for Morphe.

Highlights:

- Supports YouTube 19.16.39 only.
- Spoofs YouTube app version to 20.05.46 for modern server compatibility.
- Adds player request header spoofing to avoid playback error 400.
- Adds missing resource fallbacks to prevent Resource ID #0x0 crashes.
- Disables server-side settings layout updates by default so RVX settings remain accessible.
- Keeps the package focused on YouTube patches for legacy 19.16.39 builds.

Credits:

- anddea/revanced-patches
- MorpheApp/morphe-patches and MorpheApp/morphe-manager
- kitadai31/revanced-patches-android6-7
